_comment: Runtime file on the runner, e.g. ~/.kcbudget/kcbudget-lab.webhooks.json (chmod 600), referenced by KCBUDGET_WEBHOOKS_FILE; or return it as KCBUDGET_WEBHOOKS from your KCBUDGET_SECRETS_COMMAND. Never store it in GitHub. Budget files reference the keys by name. Teams URLs are Workflows URLs ('Post to a channel when a webhook request is received').
